abstract: Although the greatest incidence of testicular neoplasms is in the age group 20 to 35.9% of all intrascrotal tumors occur in males over 60. They may be classified into four major groups based on the tissue origin of the tumor. The most common group comprising 50% are lymphoreticular neoplasms or lymphomas. They occur in both blacks and whites, result in a diffuse enlargement of the testis and commonly involve the epididymis and cord. Prognosis is poor and survival is usually less than two years. Germ cell tumors comprise 25% and the tumors are usually large. Most of them are the classical seminoma which has a good prognosis following orchiectomy and retroperitoneal radiation. A few are the spermatocytic seminoma which is usually benign. Three percent are teratocarcinoma with embryonal elements which is highly malignant and survival less than two years. Ten percent are tumors of gonadal stromal origin. There are two types, the Leydig cell and the more rare Sertoli cell. About one-fourth of these patients develop gynecomastia and some a decrease in libido. The prognosis is good as less than 10% of these tumors are malignant. Neoplasms of supportive and paratesticular structures comprise a heterogeneous group of benign and malignant lesions and comprise about 15% of intrascrotal tumors. Most of them have the same features as tumors of similar tissues encountered throughout the body. They are the mesothelioma or adenomatoid tumor, fibroma, rhabdomyosarcoma, leiomyoma, lipoma, liposarcoma, mucinous cystadenocarcinoma, and leiomyosarcoma. As in all intrascrotal tumors, the diagnosis, treatment, and prognosis are based on the microscopic findings after removal of the tumor.
abstract_ja: 精巣腫瘍の発生が最も多いのは20～35歳の年齢層であるが、陰嚢内腫瘍の35.9%は60歳以上の男性に発生する。陰嚢内腫瘍は組織由来に基づき4群に分類される。最も多い群（50%）はリンパ網内系腫瘍（リンパ腫）で、黒人・白人の双方にみられ、精巣のびまん性腫大を来す。通常は精巣上体と精索を侵す。予後は不良で、生存期間は通常2年未満である。胚細胞腫瘍は25%を占め、腫瘍は通常大きい。その大半は古典的セミノーマで、精巣摘除術と後腹膜放射線療法後の予後は良好である。一部は精母細胞性セミノーマで、通常は良性である。3%は胎児性成分を伴う奇形癌で、非常に悪性度が高く生存期間は2年未満である。10%は性腺間質由来の腫瘍で、ライディッヒ細胞腫とセルトリ細胞腫の2型があり、後者はまれである。性腺間質腫瘍の患者約4分の1は女性化乳房を呈し、一部は性欲減退を伴う。これらの腫瘍の悪性はまれで、予後は良好である。支持組織および精巣傍組織の腫瘍は、陰嚢内腫瘍の約15%を占める不均一な良性・悪性病変の群である。その多くは、身体の他部位にみられる同種の組織の腫瘍と同様の特徴を有する。中皮腫または腺腫様腫瘍、線維腫、横紋筋肉腫、平滑筋腫、脂肪腫、脂肪肉腫、粘液性嚢胞腺癌、平滑筋肉腫がこれに含まれる。他の陰嚢内腫瘍と同様に、診断、治療、予後は切除後の顕微鏡所見に基づいて判断される。
